long_biography.plain_text:
Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum serves as Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and as the hereditary ruler of his emirate. His public initiatives have included education and international humanitarian programmes, reflecting decades of federal and emirate responsibilities shaped by preparation within the Al Maktoum ruling family.

Equestrian sport is an enduring part of Sheikh Mohammed's public identity. A lifelong interest in horses led him to found Godolphin, which became an international racing and breeding organisation. He has also competed in endurance riding, adding personal participation to his international racing and breeding work.
